Definition: from the same as G5587; a secret calumniator:--whisperer.
BiblicalUsage: Psithyristes means a whisperer, a secret slanderer. It appears once, in Paul's long list of the sins of those who knew God and refused Him: being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness, full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity, whisperers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul puts the whisperer in the same list as the murderer, because the whisper kills a name the way the sword kills a body.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
